findings.SG02_CANCEL: Owner D14-10: a recorded fabric return is cancelled or corrected in one transaction (Native journal reversal, REVERSAL movements, material cost and PO recost queue, return facts back), history kept; later uses of the returned fabric are named and block until corrected
findings.G1_SEWING: Owner D14-14 gap G1: the connected WIP & Sewing screen records SELESAI DIJAHIT for a picked-up Potongan (as the UX demo card does) through one Native step: a POSTED work completion (piece-work wage to the Mandor payable) and the sewing terminal event that Laundry counts as ready to send; cancel only while the pieces are still at the Mandor and the wage is outside payroll and any active attendance pool; base-component rates only (SKU-wave rates refused as WAVE_SKU_RATES), a PO model without a Work BOM refused as NO_WORK_RATE; before the first record the screen shows the estimated wage from the rates the Native snapshot would take (Mandor rate, else Work BOM default), and the outcome reports the wage actually posted
findings.G2_PO_FINISH: Owner D14-14 gap G2: the connected HPP & Rekalkulasi screen finishes a Production Order (UX demo HPP checklist line "Produksi sudah selesai") through the accepted Native erp.finish_production_order only: it shows the Native preconditions (laundry back or claim settled, laundry GOOD through QC, no open BS case, finished goods exist), the PO WIP balance and the Native completeness list before the click; the command refuses a stale review, ends with the PO FINISHED and its WIP balance zero, and cannot be undone from the app
findings.R2_01_CASH: Round dfab13bf, owner D15-1: Fable FABLE-013 (the D14-3 guard judged only the economic date while the owner cash report uses the book date; a closed-period income booked today let an expense leave yesterday at -500) and Sol SOL-R1-001 (a correction of an income already spent was refused on its half-way balance, before its replacement). The guard now judges both dates, and the customer payment correction, misc correction and sales note correction open a compound scope so the guard judges their end state; a scope left open refuses the whole transaction at commit; the detector lists both dates. Fable's and Sol's scenarios run with their own amounts.
findings.R2_06_SERIES: Round dfab13bf: Astra ASTRA-C17-01 (a series was keyed by the commercial SKU text alone, so the same SKU number of a second brand joined the first brand's series) and ASTRA-C17-02 (the invoice could be saved while the other sizes of a picked series were still loading). The connected sales screen keys a series by brand name plus commercial SKU from the server row, cancels the review the moment a pick starts and blocks saving until the sizes are in. The D14-5 browser fixture adds a second brand with the same series SKU (size 32, stock 5) that must stay out of the invoice with its stock unchanged.
findings.R2_05_PO: Round dfab13bf: Astra ASTRA-C17-05 (the PO finish panel called the HPP final while the server said BELUM_LENGKAP/ESTIMATED, and its workspace said eligible while Native refused: six cut pieces neither sewn-and-sent nor through direct QC) and Fable FABLE-014 (no way to reopen a finished PO from the app; the source comment wrongly said no Native inverse exists). The finish workspace now carries the exact predicate of Native erp.guard_finished_po_source_accounting (SOURCE_UNACCOUNTED), the panel words the HPP from display_status only, and po-reopen.sql reopens through Native erp.reopen_production_order with a review token, reason, idempotency, immutable history and three blockers (NOT_FINISHED, FG_USED, PERIOD_CLOSED). Astra's three journeys run with her own arithmetic; Fable's D15-4 oracle (reopen, ledger-consistent WIP, same HPP on finishing again, two tabs one winner, HTTP, browser) is covered.
findings.R2_03_MASTER: Round r2: Fable FABLE-017, Astra ASTRA-C17-04 and the known daily-master gap: customers, suppliers/laundry vendors, Mandor (dated attendance/Special policy), warehouses/locations, fabric (profile, benchmark price versions) and accessories (category, variant, Mandor price) had no connected screen, and a new Mandor or model had no rate for "Catat selesai jahit". master.sql and rates.sql add one closed facade per screen over the Native writers and guards (review token, reason, idempotency, immutable history, used records cannot change code/type/unit or be deactivated while open or stocked, nothing is ever deleted), Mandor work rates per model x work component from a date, and the model's Work BOM. The sewing workspace now previews the rates valid at the sewing time entered (rate_timeline, Native snapshot rule) instead of today's. Fable's D15-3 oracle: every master screen on desktop and phone, HTTP, two tabs per screen, and the screen-only chain new Mandor + new rate -> Bagi Potongan -> Catat selesai jahit paying the rate valid on the sewing date, a later rate change leaving the recorded wage unchanged. CI run 38861916560 (109/113): a stocked warehouse from older data whose code is stored in lower case could not be edited at all, because the facade upper-cases codes and then read the stored code in another case as a code change of a used record; the stored code in another case is now no code change and is kept exactly as stored (Native case and the stocked-warehouse browser step).
findings.R2_04_AUTO_PO: Round r2: Sol SOL-R1-002, owner D15-6. Buat Potongan had no way to make the PO the cutting belongs to; a new model needed a PO made elsewhere first. auto-po.sql (schema cp7_cutting_correction) adds one closed facade: a draft lives only in the facade (no PO, stock or journal); POST takes the next free PO number of the cutting day (WIB) under an advisory lock, inserts the PO as the Native lifecycle requires (DRAFT at CUTTING), posts the cutting through the Native writer erp_save_cutting_group_before_sewing_v2 in the same transaction and returns the PO number; any Native refusal (roll not available, cutting time in the future, size outside the model) leaves no PO, no stock movement and the number unused; the same UUID returns the stored answer and a changed payload under it is refused. Tests: one transaction, same UUID same answer (Native, two tabs, real-Auth HTTP, and on screen after a lost answer), failure midway, draft without effect, access rights, then Bagi Potongan and Catat selesai jahit on the new PO.
findings.R2_11_CUTOVER: Fable FABLE-011, owner D15-5: there was no global cutover floor for writers that bring in goods or value. cutover.sql (schema cp7_cutover): the owner sets the official date (WIB) in the app on the Impor data awal page, with an immutable history, idempotent per actor and request; the date may not lie after the first operational day already in the books nor after any import batch cutover. Until set nothing changes. Once set, BEFORE INSERT triggers refuse journal entries (economic date) and material/FG stock movements (WIB date of physical_at) dated before it, whichever writer inserts them, except the opening/migration postings and inverses of existing rows; an import batch may not take an earlier cutover date. Postings and the owner change serialise on one control row. Tests: the date boundary (00:00 on the day posts, 23:59:59 the day before is refused, for a journal and for stock), the opening path (import at the official date, original receipt date kept, late invoice after cutover, settlement after cutover, GRNI/AP once, reversal on its path), failure in the middle of a correction (nothing stays), resending (same answer; a refused request stays refused), two tabs, setting against a posting of the day before, real-Auth HTTP, and the screen on desktop and phone.
findings.R2_10_WAVE: Sol KNOWN-BF-WAVE (S1): a Potongan bound to SKU waves (BF commercial ranges) could not record SELESAI DIJAHIT (WAVE_SKU_RATES). Now RECORD_WAVE records pieces per SKU of the wave (each SKU covering its bound sizes) in one transaction: per SKU one work completion on that SKU's Native snapshot (erp.bf_ensure_work_v1 through the same ensure; SKU rate per component, else the base rate) and its SELESAI_DIJAHIT; per-SKU remaining = pieces cut in its sizes minus what is already completed/payable per component (the Native per-SKU guard). Before the first record the screen shows per SKU the rates the Native snapshot takes at the sewing time entered (sewing_wave_at, compared with the Native writer at four instants). The single-quantity base path refuses a wave Potongan (CP7_SEWING_WAVE_PER_SKU); a Native base-rate line on it stays refused (BF_WORK_SCOPE_REQUIRED).
findings.R2_07_SCREEN_CHAIN: FABLE-016 (S3), ASTRA-C17-07 (S2), Sol BROWSER-CHAIN: one browser chain on the screens only, from masters and opening WIP created on 'Impor data awal' (CSV files, check, post) to 'Rincian produksi awal' (WIP to brand-A goods), 'Ganti Merek' (to brand B), 'Laporan & Tutup Buku' (books closed through that day in the middle of the chain), 'Penjualan & Invoice' and its payment into a bank, and the books reopened; the closed days' books stay exactly as closed. Fixture only for a bank account (no screen) and harness state (chain month opened, seed open items cleared, restored). Second chain, same start: the imported Mandor's work component and rate on 'Master Data → Mandor', 3 WIP pieces split off as BS ('Pisahkan sebagai BS'), the imported product's accessory recipe declared without accessories on 'Produk & SKU' (a rework needs the product's accessory BOM valid when it is sent; the SKU master writes it from now on, so the rework is sent now), the BS case classified with that component (none done before the BS; a piece split off from opening WIP carries no work component), a rework order to that Mandor with the component as wage basis and its result on 'Barang BS & Rework', the rework wage in a Nota posted to payroll ('Susun Nota FG'), the payroll counted, approved and paid ('Payroll & Kasbon'); fixture adds owner capital for exactly that wage. Attendance HPP pool: no screen runs that cycle and r2 adds none; it stays a recorded open boundary, not an owner decision. Context only, owner D15-2 on the attendance screens in Enteng, verbatim: "sembunyikan begitu terhubung langsung muncul, doesnt matter juga kalau mau langsung muncul karena gabakal dipakai juga jadi ga kerja 2 kali sih klo mau munculin".
findings.R3_01_AUTO_PO_NUMBER: Astra ASTRA-R2-02 (S1), Sol SOL-R2-001 (S2), candidate 2e9d6a46: the automatic PO number of Buat Potongan could not pass 999 on one cutting day, because auto-po.sql formatted it with lpad(n,3), which cuts 1000 to 100, so the search for a free number never ended (statement timeout; nothing was left behind). Three digits is now the minimum width. The auditors' own failing cases are used as written: Sol's 998 and 999 unused DRAFT headers with a 3 s limit (999 and 1000 must be made), Astra's empty day with 998 headers then 999 and 1000 (roll 10 -> 8 -> 6) under a 10 s limit; plus 1001 and 9999 -> 10000, a refused post that uses no number and a resend with the same UUID past 1000, and two sessions posting at the 999/1000 boundary (two distinct numbers, both posted).
findings.R3_02_PO_REOPEN_ACTIVE_USE: Astra ASTRA-R2-01 (S1), candidate 2e9d6a46: the FG_USED blocker of the PO reopen (owner D15-4) summed every historical outflow of the PO's production lots, so a cancelled sales draft or a reversed finished-goods adjustment kept the PO blocked forever. It now counts only use that is still active: an outflow minus what its own reversals (reversal_of_id) put back; an unrelated inflow never offsets an active use. Astra's two cases are used as written (cancelled draft: stock 10 -> 8 -> 10, accounts as before; reversed -2 adjustment: stock and HPP as before, account delta of Native sync_po_hpp_to_gl that Astra qualified), plus controls: an active draft still blocks, a +2 adjustment does not offset an active 2-piece draft, cancelling one of two drafts leaves the other blocking (5 then 3), reopen after the cancel then finish again gives the same stock and HPP, and two tabs reopen once.
findings.R3_09_RATE_CHOICE: Owner D16-2, D16-3, D16-4 (not an audit finding): when the Mandor rate in force at a later sewing time differs from the rate the PO locked at its first wage, the record pays the locked rate or the new one by explicit choice (refused without one, and refused with one where the rates are equal or the PO is switched); 'Pakai tarif baru seterusnya' switches the PO once, with a reason, never undone, after which records take the new rate without asking. Only Owner/Admin record or switch. A new rate is paid through a rate revision row of the PO snapshot written only by the CP7 command (declared Native deltas cp7_rate_revision_bundle.py: snapshot index gains committed_at, bf_ensure_work_v1 pins new SKUs from original base rows, prepare_rework_component_line SKU branch and seed_bs_case_component_baseline take the latest row; the index restore refuses while revisions exist). Cases: same rate no choice, changed rate needs a choice, OLD and NEW wages from Native lines and journals, revision reuse per sewing time, switch and its refusals, D16-4 role refusal, cancel of a new-rate record, payroll pipeline and unchanged Native detectors, wave per SKU, declared deltas and restore refusal, immutable private tables; two tabs choosing NEW, switch against record; real Auth HTTP; browser desktop and phone.

oracle_independence: Dates from the Native accrual journals and source rows; balances from journal lines and stock movements; never from the guard functions.
fixture_capital: Banks that pay hold owner capital through the accepted Native journal (scripts/cp7_cash_funding.py) only where a case says so; empty-bank cases keep the bank empty.
